additional_info.subject: The issue isn't resolved but we find a way to run the charger on.
additional_info.body:
I'm closing the case for temporarily because we don't need all of the converters at the moment since the charger is running on 100 kW by customer request. We will raise a new ticket when we need to get back to 180 kW again with referencing this ticket.
ad hoc fix:
Issue isnt caused by KF13. It's converters shutdown or can com cable. So when we took the faulty converter out, we saw that charger is working fine. As we don't need 4 converters since the customer requested to charger operate limited to 100 kW for now, we configured the CG differently. But we will need a permanent solution eventually.
